name: apk-сборка-докер
command: docker build -f Dockerfile-apk --build-arg NETSHIFT_VERSION=0.9.8-test --cpus=6 --memory=8g -t netshift:ci-apk-local . 2>&1 | tail -5 && rm -f /tmp/apk-pkg.tar && cid=$(docker create netshift:ci-apk-local) && docker cp "$cid":/builder/bin/packages/x86_64/utilities/. /tmp/netshift-apk-out/ 2>/dev/null; docker cp "$cid":/builder/bin/packages/x86_64/luci/. /tmp/netshift-apk-out/ 2>/dev/null; docker rm "$cid" >/dev/null; ls -la /tmp/netshift-apk-out/ && echo "BUILD DONE"
